scope: Previously viewed synthetic development records, not independent validation
local_axis_policy: Same per-axis observed range, minimum 10mm, six times full-record noise proxy, multiplied by 1.5; no clipping
schedule: Sorted cases and windows; alternate atlas-first and single-first between targets
review_policy: Review every event from single-window activity; common <=7 unknown-day bridge, never bridge known negatives; output confined to candidate; no truth-selected crops
aggregation: Strict majority of all covering window views; failures and unknowns retain denominator; ties unknown; original missing days unknown
stage_policy: Same saved XGBoost and observation feature support for all new and historical visual gates; no fitting or threshold search
comparisons: window_atlas versus window_single: same target prompt, global context, call count and axis rule; image detail and image tokens differ
window_single versus window_single_review: same candidates and saved stage head; extra pure-visual confirmation calls
historical full-record atlas and strong numeric gates are references, not same-budget controls
primary_measure: Activity daily F1, jointly interpreted with precision, recall, negative FP days, weak recall, coverage and failures
interpretation_limits: One weak episode, six viewed records, correlated AI-assisted labels, one repetition and offline centered features; no confirmatory significance or field generalization claim
